digest.component_or_area: plan review rubric T11 (post-rollback schema state)
propositions: T11 post-rollback paragraph generates tautological false-positive findings (~0.1 priority) for append-only stores, obscuring genuine data-loss risks
Post-rollback findings should only raise when plans change interpretation of existing records, rewrite/migrate in place, remove/narrow read paths, or perform irreversible one-way transformations

Purely additive backward-compatible changes (new record types, optional fields, new tables/columns with defaults) should not trigger post-rollback findings since residual data after rollback is expected in append-only and backward-compatible systems
The applicability rule must be store-technology-agnostic to apply equally to SQL migrations, event stores, document databases, and config formats
